maddeler.e:
حففت (form I)
# حَفَفْتُ (ḥafaftu) /ħa.faf.tu/: first-person singular past active of حَفَّ (ḥaffa)
# حَفَفْتَ (ḥafafta) /ħa.faf.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of حَفَّ (ḥaffa)
# حَفَفْتِ (ḥafafti) /ħa.faf.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of حَفَّ (ḥaffa)
# حُفِفْتُ (ḥufiftu) /ħu.fif.tu/: first-person singular past passive of حَفَّ (ḥaffa)
# حُفِفْتَ (ḥufifta) /ħu
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
